Bug_Title: Classes that don't define "hashCode()" should not be used in hashes
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the Student class, which defines an equals method but does not define a hashCode method. This causes issues when instances of Student are used as keys in a Hashtable, as equal instances can have different hash codes leading to unexpected behavior.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by adding two equal Student objects with different hash codes to a Hashtable. The second put operation overrides the first one, causing the test to fail when asserting the grade of the first student.
